headline.description: Three to five sentences an operator can act on without opening anything else: what this build looks like, the one thing to fix first, and what is fine and should be left alone.

order.description: Finding ids, most worth fixing first. Rank by (harm × how many people meet it × how small the fix is), not by severity label alone.

duplicates.description: Groups where several critics found the same defect. The first id is the one to keep.

disagreements.description: Where the critics or refuters contradicted each other. Do not resolve these silently — name them.
